resolve_component_cls: resolve the component class from a pretrained model name or path using model_index.json
resolve_component_cls_local: resolve the component class from a local directory path containing model_index.json
resolve_component_cls_hub: resolve the component class from a Hugging Face Hub model repo with optional revision and cache_dir
resolve_component_cls_diffusers: resolve the diffusers pipeline class from a pretrained model name or path
resolve_component_cls_unet: resolve the UNet model class from a pretrained model name or path
